mainEntity.name: How long does room addition framing usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on size and complexity, but framing a room addition is often one of the faster major stages once the site is ready. Smaller additions may take days, while larger additions with complex roof tie-ins, second-story work, or multiple openings can take longer. In the Denver metro area, weather and permit timing can also affect the schedule. If you want a realistic timeline, ask for both the framing duration and the inspection window, because those are not always the same thing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small additions may be framed in a few days, while larger or more complex additions can take longer. Weather, inspections, and roof tie-ins can extend the timeline in the Denver area.
